title: Serialize network registry snapshots with durable saves
summary: Serialize in-flight network registry snapshots with their durable save and deep-copy nested state.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-017. Current bundled-runtime reproduction persisted only job-old after a newer two-job snapshot had already been saved.
behavior_before: Registry snapshots were captured before save serialization, allowing an older snapshot to overwrite a newer durable generation; nested worker statistics remained mutable after the registry lock was released.
behavior_after: Registry save now acquires the save-order lock before the registry lock, deep-copies the complete JSON snapshot, and retains atomic fsynced replacement, so queued saves cannot publish stale generations or observe later nested mutations.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_registry_save_order.py: deterministic reverse-order save blocking and nested worker-stat snapshot immutability regressions.
